ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: GluciAI uses the camera to analyse your meals, scan barcodes and photograph your lab reports.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: GluciAI lets you import a meal or lab report photo from your library.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: GluciAI uses the microphone so you can talk to the AI assistant and log your meals, glucose and insulin by voice.
